facts.text: The resort is perched in the foothills overlooking Beppu, with views of lush mountains, Beppu Bay and natural hot springs.
facts.excerpt: Perched in the foothills overlooking Beppu, ANA InterContinental Beppu Resort & Spa offers breathtaking views of lush mountains, Beppu Bay, and natural hot springs.

facts.text: The Myoban Onsen Retreat is a rustic open-air bath crafted from Beppu stone, with panoramic views of Beppu Bay and the city below.
facts.excerpt: Crafted from Beppu stone, our rustic open-air bath offers panoramic views of Beppu Bay and the city below.

facts.text: The onsen uses the waters of Myoban, one of Beppu's renowned hot spring areas, celebrated for their skin-beautifying qualities.
facts.excerpt: Discover the soothing waters of Myoban, one of Beppu’s renowned hot spring areas, celebrated for their skin-beautifying qualities.

facts.text: HARNN Heritage Spa was created by HARNN, a luxury brand from Thailand, and draws on Eastern traditions and natural healing practices.
facts.excerpt: Created by HARNN, a luxury brand from Thailand, HARNN Heritage Spa draws inspiration from the time-honored traditions of the East and natural healing practices.

facts.text: The spa experience is inspired by the nature and culture of Beppu and Oita.
facts.excerpt: Embrace a unique spa experience inspired by the nature and culture of Beppu, Oita

facts.text: The outdoor infinity pool has an open-air view of Beppu, a patio with sunloungers and a jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an incomparable view under the open air of Beppu. After the swim, lie back on the patio in one of the 12 sunloungers or relax in the jacuzzi.

facts.text: The infinity pool is heated.
facts.excerpt: Water type: Heated pool

facts.text: Rooms have calming Japanese-inspired design with modern amenities.
facts.excerpt: Each room has been planned for optimal comfort, with calming Japanese-inspired design and modern amenities to meet every need.

facts.text: Guests are welcomed with a glass of original blend TWG tea.
facts.excerpt: We're also pleased to welcome guests with a glass of original blend TWG tea.

facts.text: Classic Rooms may include a balcony and a private onsen.
facts.excerpt:
Classic Rooms may include:

- Balcony
- Private Onsen

facts.text: The Panorama Suite may include a balcony, a private onsen and Beppu Bay views.
facts.excerpt:
Panorama Suite may include:

- Balcony
- Private Onsen
- Beppu Bay View, Beppu City View

facts.text: The One Bedroom Suite may include an outdoor hot tub.
facts.excerpt:
- Private Onsen
- Outdoor Hot Tub

facts.text: The restaurants, bars and lounges are inspired by Japan's five elements of earth, water, fire, wind and void.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Japan’s five elements — earth, water, fire, wind, and void — our restaurants, bars, and lounges integrate the essence and the beauty of nature into their dishes, drinks, and décor.

facts.text: Sushi Musui serves seasonal seafood sourced from the coastline of Bungo Oita.
facts.excerpt: Bungomae Musui invites you to indulge in a curated selection of seasonal delicacies, sourced from the everchanging coastline of Bungo Oita

facts.text: Atelier is a dinner-only restaurant with a modern open kitchen serving European cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Atelier is an exclusive, dinner only venue that gives a taste of the cutting edge in culinary creativity. In its modern open kitchen, our skilled chefs will enthrall guests with exceptional European cuisine.

facts.text: Elements has a terrace with a view of the Myoban mountain area.
facts.excerpt: Or take a meal in one of the 24 seats out on the terrace to be truly enveloped in nature, with a gorgeous view of the Myoban mountain area.

facts.text: The Bar serves craft gin, prime whiskeys and Japanese shochu.
facts.excerpt: Savour a unique selection of craft gin, prime whiskeys, and Japanese shochu at Bar.

facts.text: Beppu offers thermal pools, sand baths and hell-steamed seafood among its hot spring sights and experiences.
facts.excerpt: With its visually striking thermal pools, soothing sand baths, and “hell-steamed” seafood, Beppu has an extensive offering of hot spring-themed sights and experiences.

facts.text: Oita Airport is about 40.6 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: approximately 25.23 miles away (40.6 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking is available at ANA InterContinental Beppu Resort & Spa for hotel guests.

facts.text: The hotel is in the Kannawa area of Beppu.
facts.excerpt: 499-18 Oaza Kannawa Beppu
